chapter_notes_tr: Fadyme'nin açılışta bildiği bir aylık doktor tahmini, çanların hızlandırdığı lanet nedeniyle haftalara düşmüştür. Bu yeni tahmini Mahmut'tan saklar. Şifa loncası ve Red Vial hikâyesi tamamlanır.

scenes.direction_en: Odelia’s chalk arrows lead beneath the city. The water is still, but something moves against its reflection.

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: Some enemies bypass the Front and strike the Rear. Speed, healing and a balanced five-hero formation answer them.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: Do not look for ripples. These things follow the shape of your shadow.
How did you find the tunnel?
I followed the people who stopped coming back.

post_battle_lines.text_en: The nest is behind us. The Guild ward is ahead.
You did not have to follow us down here.
I dislike unanswered tracks. Yours are the loudest.

scenes.direction_en: Tilda and Iona have turned a storage room into a clinic. Kera sets the recovered ledger beside their medicine jars.

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: Healing and shields resolve automatically when their conditions are met. Check the action log to read each effect and duration.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: We have one clean table and three patients. I can make it four if you stop bleeding on it.
She means welcome. Sit down before you fall down.
I brought the ledger. Do not let anyone spill medicine on it.

post_battle_lines.text_en: The poison is gone. Fear takes longer.
We will reopen this ward after the Guild is settled.
You have given the city a place to breathe.
Then keep breathing while you are in it.
The captain's order you carried, Sir Knight. It does not ask for her. It asks for her blood, sealed and delivered.
Then someone in my Guild wrote a recipe around a person.

scenes.direction_en: Clem unlocks a narrow archive room. Mahmut waits at the stairwell while Fadyme asks for a private reading.

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: Fadyme’s inner thoughts are voiced in Japanese and shown only to the player. Mahmut does not hear them.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: You asked for a truth with no witnesses. I can give you one.
Not a month now. Weeks, perhaps less, if the bell keeps calling.
Then perhaps the bell will take the answer from someone else.

post_battle_lines.text_en: He will ask what I told you.
Tell him the elixir might work.
That is a lie.
It is a small one. Let me keep it.
Mahmut has already given enough years to my name.

scenes.direction_en: Fadyme returns with a sealed vial. Kera recognizes the mixture from the guild ledger and sees the label is false. Later, alone, Fadyme refolds the letter from the forest road and tucks it deeper into her mother's prayer book.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: The label is wrong. The recipe is incomplete.
Then complete it. You are good at turning bad mixtures into useful ones.
And those are Chain Cultists on the stair. They pray to an eclipse that never moves, and they pay the Guild in silver for glass.

post_battle_lines.text_en: I will try. I will not promise a cure.
That is enough for tonight.
He accepted a hope because I asked him to. I will have to live with that.

scenes.direction_en: The Matron seals herself behind a glass ward and floods the chamber with corrosive vapor.

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: Breakable arena objects have their own health bar. Destroy the flask racks to reduce the Matron’s area damage.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: The heir’s blood is not a cure. It is the last ingredient.
I knew the Guild was using the wrong formula. I did not know it was using her.
Break the flasks. Do not let her finish the sentence.

post_battle_lines.text_en: I am staying to copy every page of the antidote archive.
Iona and I will reopen the clinic. The patients need a door that stays open.
We will come back for you.
Bring the missing formula. I will bring the rest.
Oakhaven has no smith while I am down here. I am going home to hold the gate. Send word when something needs a door.
Weeks. Perhaps less. The words do not become kinder when repeated.

scenes.battle_transition_en: Kera remains to preserve the archive; Tilda and Iona return to the clinic.

scenes.direction_en: The river city at dusk. Beneath its bridges, drainage mouths breathe cold air. Chalk arrows mark one of them.

lines.text_en: Someone marked that tunnel. Neat arrows. Harbor knots.
The Undercity. Everything the city does not want to see goes down there. Including my Guild.
Stay close below. The dark down there is not like the forest.
I know. The forest at least whispered.

scenes.direction_en: They climb out of the Undercity at dawn. Fadyme stops on the last stair to feel the sun.

lines.text_en: The sun is warm. I had forgotten it was allowed to be.
The elixir. Did Kera say when?
Soon. She is very good at soon.
Weeks. I will spend some of them standing in the sun. That much I can choose.
East, then. The estate schedule is somewhere past the ravine.
